items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: And after he went we picked up a woman from Attacan, Kansas. Her name was Vivian. I don't remember my last name but man, could she play some piano?

ctx.x: But he left us in Omaha. He had to go make some records.

He had to go, some blues singer, a woman he knew in Chicago had sent for him to make some records. He was in Omaha. But he could stop or dance. That's right. That boy would get in one of them cab rats and get to play on that piano. He had one blues he would play. People would actually stop dancing and come stand around that piano. That's right. They would stop in the middle of the floor and just get to walk and see them one at a time, something like a moving picture. You see them just walking by that piano. And…
